component_splits.review: Split the welded body into 66 leaf/window-surround faces and 30 U-frame faces; preserve all original vertices, UVs and material.

clearance_review: A 0.4% moving fit supplies about 1.86 mm per jamb and 4.32 mm top clearance in the original zero-clearance opening.
modifications: Normalize the selected source to a centered, floor-aligned Z-up meter frame without reflection.
Separate the original welded leaf and frame along the recorded whole-face selections.
Apply only the recorded clearance, collider and hinge approximations; start closed and already unlatched.
